マスター漢字

Master kanji shapes, from N5 to N2. All 1,104 kanji in 62 chapters (981 from the N5 to N2 lists, plus 123 more that the site's sentences use), with a level switch that includes every easier level: N4 shows N5 and N4, N2 shows everything. Built Heisig's way: learn the shape, learn what it gets confused with, then learn its readings through real words. Four ways in: Course (shape families, starting with the twelve master shapes), Flashcards, Sound index (parts that give the sound, and shared readings) and By topic.
